name: pretix
description: pretix is an open-source ticketing and event-registration platform available as a hosted service or self-hosted deployment.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated pretix Hosted team token for one organizer and read only a bounded page of event summaries or one exact event without orders, attendees or financial data.

credentialRequirements.name: PRETIX_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: pretix team API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated team-level token with only event-read authority and store it encrypted.

credentialRequirements.name: PRETIX_ORGANIZER
credentialRequirements.label: pretix organizer slug
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact pretix Hosted organizer slug this connection may read.

capabilities.label: Read event metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded event summaries for one pretix Hosted organizer without order, attendee or financial data.

allowed.label: List events
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five event summaries from the first page of one pretix Hosted organizer.

allowed.label: Read an event
allowed.description: Read one exact pretix event metadata summary.

blocked.label: Block people and financial data
blocked.description: Orders, attendees, invoices, payments, check-ins, answers, vouchers and other people or financial records are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block mutations
blocked.description: Event, order, ticket, check-in, settings and every other mutation are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw and arbitrary-host access
blocked.description: Raw responses, arbitrary endpoints, automatic pagination and self-hosted origins are not exposed in this fixed-origin slice.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Only bounded event metadata reads for the configured organizer run directly.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same two selected reads run without Relay per-action approval; token authority, organizer boundary, fixed origin and redaction remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed event reads and sends the encrypted token only to pretix Hosted for the configured organizer.
Relay mounts two typed event reads and sends the encrypted token only to pretix Hosted for the configured organizer.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates a least-privilege team token, enters it with the exact organizer slug, then selects event-read capability and policy per agent install.

evidence.supports: pretix documents customer-created team-level API tokens sent as an Authorization Token header.
pretix documents organizer-scoped event list and exact-event endpoints with public event metadata fields.
pretix documents paginated list envelopes and a page_size query capped at fifty; Relay further caps this connector at twenty-five and never follows next links.
